title: General Rule of Property Division
text: In a decree of divorce or annulment, the court shall order a division of the estate of the parties in a manner that the court deems just and right, having due regard for the rights of each party and any children of the marriage.
history: Added by Acts 1997, 75th Leg., ch. 7, Sec. 1, eff. April 17, 1997.
